mitdb.facts: 48 half-hour two-channel 360 Hz ambulatory ECG recordings from 47 subjects; cardiologist reference beat annotations.
mitdb.recommended_original_citation: Moody GB, Mark RG. The impact of the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database. IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Magazine. 2001;20(3):45–50.

mitdb_directory.facts: Records 201 and 202 came from the same subject; lead configurations vary, record 114 reverses channel order, and records 102/104/107/217 include paced beats.

nstdb.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
nstdb.facts: The bw, ma and em records predominantly contain baseline wander, muscle artifact and electrode motion artifact, recorded from physically active volunteers with electrodes arranged to avoid visible ECG.
nstdb.recommended_original_citation: Moody GB, Muldrow WE, Mark RG. A noise stress test for arrhythmia detectors. Computers in Cardiology. 1984;11:381–384.
nstdb.bibliographic_note: The dataset page prints Muldrow WE. The manuscript retains Muldrow WK, consistent with the original archival reference audit and the same authors' 1989 paper hosted by PhysioNet; this discrepancy is documented rather than silently replacing the publication identity.
nstdb.manuscript_original_citation: Moody GB, Muldrow WK, Mark RG. A noise stress test for arrhythmia detectors. Computers in Cardiology. 1984;11:381–384.
